name: gcgmao-videos
description: Videos comerciales de GC GMAO hechos con Remotion

scripts.render:todo: npm run render:sitio && npm run comprimir:sitio
scripts.comprimir:sitio: ffmpeg -y -i out/gcgmao-sitio.mp4 -c:v libx264 -b:v 500k -preset slow -pass 1 -passlogfile out/p2 -an -f null /dev/null && ffmpeg -y -i out/gcgmao-sitio.mp4 -c:v libx264 -b:v 500k -preset slow -pass 2 -passlogfile out/p2 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -movflags +faststart out/gcgmao-sitio-landing.mp4
